title: The studio behind Pokémon struggles to find its voice in Beast of Reincarnation
summary: Game Freak’s new action game is full of ideas you’ve seen and played before. At first, Beast seems like Dark Souls or Elden Ring , a game built around dodging and parrying, with little room for error.
